ios.desc:
You’re busy, so we built an efficient app that saves your precious time and frees up your schedule to work on other things. Nexticy Cloud for iPad is a unique approach to simplifying the creation and management of digital forms. Often, these tools can feel uninspired and lack enthusiasm, but the comprehensive spirit of Nexticy should surprise users of even the most full featured apps. 

With just a few taps, perform rapid client registrations, collect and organize reports, assemble feedback and reviews, generate continuous questionnaires, tests, and more. In short, Nexticy is a professional grade, full-service software that is geared to boost and improve whatever you have in mind. 

With Nexticy, you can also:

- create your own custom forms from scratch or choose from over 200 premium free templates (via formbox.net) to perfectly suit your tastes and needs
- publicly or privately disperse your forms via email, social media, file hosting services, and company page
- collect responses in one convenient spreadsheet for speedy reference
- analyze & integrate collected data with various CRM systems, databases and other services (e.g. Salesforce, Evernote, Google Docs, ZOHO CRM, Quickbooks, Zappier and more)

The power of Nexticy Cloud offers so much more than simply building and receiving form results, advancing it well beyond novelty use. 

Whether you’re in the office and want to create reports to keep track of meetings or working in the classroom where you’ll need to construct tests for students, the options are limitless. Thanks to the easy to use features, your employees can quickly fill daily reports or take advantage of useful built-in calculation tools for invoices and price estimates. 

Try using Nexticy to make beautiful spreads for announcements and flyers or create strategic templates to regularly send out to your preferred clients. 

Though generated as completely digital documents, Nexticy forms still retain the familiarity of paper-based documents with their look and functionality. Effortless printing and data entry means greater results and the powerful software ensures not only bigger, but better. When building the best products, information is vital. 

Because Nexticy Cloud plays to your creative strengths, the only limitation is your imagination. With a nearly endless source of possibility, this really is the ideal blend of beauty and brains.
